Find the position of a gene

Source: R/lookup.R
find_gene.Rd

Looks up a human gene by its symbol (for example "LCT" or "MC1R") in the Ensembl database and returns where it sits in the genome (GRCh38 assembly).

Usage

find_gene(symbol)

Arguments

symbol

A gene symbol, or a vector of them.

Value

A tibble with one row per gene: gene, chrom (chromosome, e.g. "chr2"), start, end, strand and description.

Details

Gene symbols are the short official names approved by the HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee. If you are unsure of a symbol, search for the gene at https://www.genenames.org or https://www.ensembl.org.

Genes listed in teaching_genes are looked up there first, so they work without an internet connection.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
find_gene("LCT")
find_gene(c("MC1R", "SLC24A5"))
} # }
